sections.rationale: Introduces the full experimental register E0–E9 and ablation matrix A0–A9, laying out the design and scope of all planned tests.
Provides detailed descriptions of ablations E4–E7 covering singularity-detector AUROC, IDF weighting, group-quotient attention, and reservoir-readout efficiency.
Reports the concrete MNIST experiment achieving 97.78% accuracy with typed states and confusion-graph singularity detection as a proof-of-concept.
Describes the selection of the BabyAI dataset and its compositional instruction grammar as the testbed for hierarchical task and state-machine evaluation.

Presents the synthetic BabyAI-like grid experiment showing graph-mask boosting accuracy from 86.5% to 96.8% and the typed-feature gain of +10 accuracy, including the boundary condition where current-state identity reduces the benefit.
